senses.gloss:
f. (-षा)
Drowsiness, sleepiness, wish to sleep.
E.
शी to sleep, desid. v., अङ् and टाप् aff.

mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु)
Sleepy, drowsy.
E.
शी to sleep, desid. v., उ aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Cold, frigid, chilly, freezing.
m. (-रः)
Frost.
mn. (-रः-रं)
The cold season, comprising two months from about the middle of January to that of March.
E.
शश to go, (the sun, north of the equator,) किरच् Uṇādi aff. and the radical vowel changed to इ.

n. (-लं)
The dewy season; see the last.
E.
शिशिर, and काल time.

m. (-शुः)
1 The young of man or any animal, a child, a calf, a pup, &c.
2 A pupil, a scholar.
3 A boy under eight years of age.
4 A lad, or boy not more than sixteen.
E.
शो to destroy, Uṇādi aff. उ, and the root repeated, with इ substituted for the semivowel to which the radical vowel is changed in its inflections.

m. (-कः)
1 A porpoise.
2 Another fish, resembling a porpoise.
3 A child, a young animal.
4 A tree.
E.
कन् added to the last.

m. (-न्दः)
The weeping of an infant or child.
E.
शिशु a child, and क्रन्द weeping; also शिशुक्रन्दन n. (-नं).

m. (-यः)
A book or work treating of infantine or juvenile grievances.
E.
शिशुक्रन्द as above, and छ aff. in this sense.

f. (-न्धा)
Double jasmine.

n. (-त्वं)
1 Boyhood, pupilage, the period before sixteen.
2 Childhood, the period up to eight years of age.
E.
शिशु a child, त्व abstract aff.; also with तल् aff. शिशुता.

m. (-लः)
The sovereign of a country in the central part of India or Cedi, opposed to KṚṢṆA and slain by him: his death forms the subject of one of the Hindu epic poems, thence named Śiśupāla Badha, by MĀGHA.
E.
शिशु a child, and पाल who cherishes.

m. (-कः)
1 A king: see the last.
2 A plant, (Nauclea cordifolia.)
E.
शिशु a child, पाल who or what pleases or cherishes, aff. कन्.

m. (-हा)
KṚṢṆA.
E.
शिशुपाल the king so named, and हन् destroyer.

m. (-रः)
1 The gangetic porpoise, (Delphinus gangeticus.)
2 The heavenly porpoise, or collection of the stars and planets.
3 A name or form of VIṢṆU.
E.
शिशु a child, and मार what kills.

m. (-कः)
A wild goat.
E.
शिशु a child, वह to bear, aff. ण्वुल्.

m. (-कः)
A wild goat.
E.
शिशु a child, वह to bear, ण्यत् aff., and कन् added.

m. (-श्नः)
The penis.
E.
शश to move, aff. नक्, form irr.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Innocent, virtuous.
2 Guilty, sinful, wicked.
E.
श्वित to be white, (pure or virtuous,) आनच् Uṇādi aff., त changed to द, and the reduplicate form of the root.

r. 1st cl. (शेषति)
To hurt, to injure or kill.
r. 1st and 10th cls. (शेषति शेषयति)
1 To leave a residue, not to use the whole.
2 (usually with षि prefixed,) To excel.
(ऌ and with षि prefixed) विशिष्टृ r. 7th cl. (विषिनष्टि)
To assign attributes or qualities to, to distinguish, to individualize, to specify.

n. (-सं)
Lead.
E.
षि to bind, क्विप् aff., सी a binding, षो to destroy, aff. क.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
1 Obedient, docile.
2 Ordered, commanded, disciplined, trained.
3 Chief, principal, eminent, select.
4 Left, remaining.
m. (-ष्टः)
1 A courtier, a counsellor.
2 A chief.
E.
शास to order, aff. क्त, form irr., or शिष to leave, क्त aff.

f. (-ता)
1 Good behaviour, urbanity, civility.
2 Docility.
3 The property of being left or remaining.
E.
शिष्टि, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, शिष्टित्व.

f. (-भा)
A council of state, an assembly of chief officers.
E.
शिष्ट, and सभा an assembly.

m. (-रः)
History or tradition of eminent persons.
E.
शिष्ट, and सभाचार account.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Well-behaved.
m. (-रः)
Good manners, proper behaviour.
E.
शिष्ट, and आचार observance.

f. (-ष्टिः)
1 An order or command.
2 Ruling, commanding.
3 Correcting, keeping in order.
4 Personal correction or chastisement.
E.
शास to order, aff. क्तिन्, form irr.

ind.
1 Having confessed publicly, or proclaimed.
2 Having governed, regulated, trained, &c.
E.
शास to rule or शिष to hurt, क्त्वा aff.

(-ष्यः)
1 A pupil, a scholar.
2 Passion, anger.
3 Violence.
E.
शास to order, aff. क्यप्, and the vowel changed to इ.

f. (-ष्टिः)
Chastisement or correction of a pupil.
E.
शिष्य, and शिष्टि correction.

mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु)
Wishing or intending to make war.
E.
सङ्ग्राम to make war, desid. v., उ aff.

f. (-षा)
Wish or purpose to effect, prove, &c.
E.
षाध to accomplish, desid. form, अङ् and टाप् affs.

mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु)
Desirous to accomplish, to prove, &c.
E.
षाध to accomplish, desid. v., उ aff.

f. (-क्षा)
Wish or purpose to create.
E.
सृज to create, desid. v., अङ् and टाप् affs.

mfn. (-क्षुः-क्षुः-क्षु)
Wishing or purposing to create.
E.
सृज to create, desid. v., उ aff.

n. (-कं)
Lead.
E.
कन् added to the last.

n. (-कं)
Lead.
